column3: “the men of Ephraim” renders the collective “the man of Ephraim”; “without calling us” renders “and did not call us.”
“were at great strife” renders “I was a man of great strife.”
“you would not deliver me” renders “you were not a deliverer”; “hands” renders “palm.”
“defeated” renders “attacked”; the Hebrew of the last clause is difficult.
“could not pronounce it correctly” renders “did not pay attention to speak right.”
“one of the cities” renders “in the cities”; some read “in his city, in Gilead.”
“gave in marriage outside the family” renders “sent outside.”
